subject: general
question: In a certain code language, GAME is written as TUZANOVW, and CAR is written as XYZAIJ. How will POST be written in that language ?
solution:
The logic follows here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a143db1d91c3a48fa05be3778bc0b392a7fb609b8f94cc51272f027e8df9e54a.png] 

GAME is written as TUZANOVW.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7169036f27db736e92ad5b39943144ff8a7fb6b856765c7115017ce266cbf288.png] 

and

CAR is written as XYZAIJ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3765590a4795b7b4988ceef12b2453246cb794c2b4b8428bb7570a4928b5550d.png] 

Similarly,

POST will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b902759791a59ac45105fdffad6e9eec3bf4ac5ce4f05154de27a4bd15722221.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"KLLMHIGH".**
